access_rights_availability_gaps: Access/rights/availability candidates are not rights clearance, open-access truth, or verified availability.
bibliographic_identity_gaps: Bibliographic identity candidates require review before any work/manifestation/identifier/holding use.
citation_relation_gaps: Citation relation candidates are not citation correctness, impact proof, or same-work clustering truth.
cultural_object_identity_gaps: Cultural object candidates are not collection completeness, object truth, media fetch permission, or rights clearance.
dataset_identity_gaps: Dataset candidates are not dataset validity, download permission, rights clearance, or malware safety.
do_not_repeat_risks: Do not treat library/research metadata as bibliographic completeness, citation correctness, dataset validity, patent validity, access rights, rights clearance, open-access truth, privacy safety, malware safety, verified availability, or public truth.
Do not use fixture replay or blocked probes as live access approval.
Do not let access metadata become fetch, harvest, query, download, or acquisition permission.
fixture_gaps: Fixtures are synthetic/public-safe and do not prove live library, repository, dataset, cultural, research, or patent behavior.
h8_handoff_recommendation: H8-BUNDLE-01 may start policy-pack-only work for manuals, technical docs, datasheets, and standards sources.
j1_k_l_deferral_recommendation: J1 risky actions, K semantic/AI, and L wider clients remain deferred unless explicit gates open.
live_probe_gaps: Blocked live probes provide gate evidence but no completed metadata response.
normalizer_gaps: Normalizers cover metadata fixture shapes, not full text, PDFs, scans, article payloads, datasets, patent documents, IIIF/media payloads, scraping, or crawling.
notes: Postmortem recommends H8 policy packs, not risky actions or production readiness.
patent_identity_gaps: Patent candidates are not legal status, grant/expiry/enforceability, or patent document download permission.
policy_gaps: source-specific live probe approvals remain absent
research_work_identity_gaps: Research work candidates are not article truth, DOI truth, preprint/reviewed-state truth, or citation truth.
restricted_source_policy_gaps: Restricted/licensed sources remain policy-blocked by default and require future legal/privacy/safety review.
review_mapping_gaps: Review seeds are not human review decisions and are not persisted.
risks: Live H7 metadata probes remain blocked pending operator approval.
source_os_reuse_assessment: H7 reused H0-H6 Source OS review gates while preserving library/cultural/research-specific boundaries.
what_failed: No H7 source has committed operator approval for a live metadata probe.
what_worked: Thirty H7 library/cultural/research sources have policy packs, fixtures, normalizers, replay outputs, fail-closed live-probe envelopes, and review previews.
Bibliographic, research work, dataset, cultural object, patent, citation, and access-rights candidates remain review-gated and candidate-only.
Live-probe outputs failed closed when committed source approvals were missing.
